note: Park owned jointly by Daviess and Martin counties on the 622-acre West Boggs Lake, funded by user fees alone, so state park passes are not valid; also two rental cabins. Red Fox, on a peninsula into the lake, is the most popular section. There is a beach, Stoll's Lakeview Restaurant, putt-putt, a 9-hole golf course, disc golf and kayak rentals. The renter must be 18 or older. --Claude
